research_question: Can a small pre-retrieval policy learn when one bounded resource component is likely to improve the next response, while defaulting off when benefit is absent or uncertain and respecting prespecified interaction/grounding-risk and cost constraints?

claim_boundary.primary_claim: conditional component gating is learnable and more selective than fixed always-on or always-off baselines
claim_boundary.minimum_success: at least one component head has reproducible grouped-OOF signal and improves the held-out quality-risk-cost table under the default-off decision rule
not_claimed: all memory sources and RS interactions are learned
item-level retrieval is learned by the PM
claim_boundary.history_disclosure: The default-off target and conditional RS stratum were clarified after the first RS outcome judge failed its frozen measurement gate. Any discovered RS stratum requires confirmation on an independent outcome-blind sample.

action_space_and_identification.interpretation: The clean-pair slices identify individual component effects; they do not replace the formal 16-action output space.
action_space_and_identification.training_strategy: Learn MP, MS, ME, and RS component effects rather than a direct 16-class argmax. Compose an action only from qualified components; a multi-component interaction that lacks its own clean evidence remains masked/default-off.
action_space_and_identification.minimum_publishable_success: At least one component effect is learned out of group; all 16 actions need not be selected or independently supported.

pm: choose whether a source-level component is off or eligible to run
compose a formally valid action from qualified MP, MS, ME, and RS component decisions
abstain to M0+R0 under missing evidence, OOD, or high uncertainty
pm_does_not: select a specific memory item or strategy card
observe gold outcome labels, oracle item IDs, raw future turns, or judge outputs
retriever_and_filters: use the same catalog, eligibility rules, and score definitions during opportunity preview and execution
the current frozen runtime retrieves source-specific top-k memory items (MP=2, MS=2, ME=3) and strategy top-k=3
the current frozen ranker is token-count lexical cosine with a strict score-above-zero floor; it does not itself prove freshness or conflict safety
realize an empty eligible set as the off action
prompt_compiler_and_generator: inject the bounded source-specific top-k selected by the frozen retriever
mark memory as evidence that may be uncertain and must not be expanded into unsupported personal claims
mark strategy cards as technique constraints rather than content to quote
produce the response with the generator, decoding, and visible-context contract held fixed across paired arms
posthoc_audit_only: verify treatment realization and item lineage
judge paired response quality and atomic risks
create labels only after all pre-retrieval features have been sealed

shared_observable_context: current session summary if it is part of the deployed visible stack
source-level availability, count, age, and estimated token cost
family-level opportunity metadata computed without revealing the selected item text
rs_minimum_features: advice explicitly welcomed, neutral, or declined
me_minimum_features: a specific prior event, commitment, or detail is available
the detail is not already present in visible context
forbidden_leakage: retrieved item text before the PM decision
response text from either experimental arm
judge scores, human preferences, or later dialogue turns
duplicate or near-duplicate user groups across train and evaluation

operational_component_definitions.M0: No longitudinal memory item enters the generator prompt.
operational_component_definitions.MP: The profile-memory source is enabled; the frozen retriever may return up to two items.
operational_component_definitions.MS: The session-summary-memory source is enabled; the frozen retriever may return up to two items.
operational_component_definitions.ME: The event-memory source is enabled; the frozen retriever may return up to three items.
operational_component_definitions.R0: No strategy-bank card enters the generator prompt.
operational_component_definitions.RS: Strategy retrieval is enabled; the frozen retriever may return up to three strategy cards.

current_runtime.current_human_reviewed_RS_catalog: exactly one frozen card per family; Top-1 after family eligibility
current_runtime.prompt_behavior: all retrieved items are serialized into the generator prompt

retrieval_cardinality_calibration.scientific_question: For memory, does Top-1 preserve or improve response quality and grounding risk relative to the current source-specific Top-k while reducing prompt cost? The current five-card RS catalog is already a family-gated Top-1 treatment.
controlled_fields: same candidate catalog and lexical-cosine ranking
same generator, decoding, system prompt, and output cap
Top-1 is the exact rank-1 prefix of the Top-k arm
retrieval_cardinality_calibration.rs_noncomparability_guard: Do not compare the five-card catalog Top-1 directly with the 11,590-card raw-bank Top-3 as a cardinality ablation; catalog quality and content change at the same time.
measures_reported_separately: input tokens and realized item count
retrieval_cardinality_calibration.selection_rule: Choose memory retrieval cardinality using train/calibration only, freeze it, and use the same chosen retrieval mechanism for learned PM and matched baselines. Freeze current RS to family-gated Top-1 unless at least three independently qualified within-family cards are later available.
retrieval_cardinality_calibration.final_evaluation_rule: The main-table evaluation cannot be used to select Top-1 versus Top-k. A prespecified cardinality ablation belongs in calibration or an appendix; the main table uses the frozen winner.
retrieval_cardinality_calibration.action_space_note: Retrieval cardinality is not added as a seventeenth-or-larger PM action dimension in V1.5.

quality.name: immediate support quality
quality.definition: For the current turn, the response better satisfies the literal request and boundary; then emotional attunement; then immediate helpfulness; then clarity/naturalness.
quality.aggregation: ordered decision criteria, not an arithmetic weighted score
quality.minimum_positive_label: treatment is decisively better with literal evidence and a nonempty decisive criterion
quality.true_tie: materially equivalent after a qualified measurement; maps to off
quality.unreliable_tie: tie produced by an unqualified or inconsistent instrument; maps to unknown and is excluded from effect training

risk.name: interaction-and-grounding risk proxy
risk.aggregation: each event keeps its own applicability denominator; no combined risk score
risk.memory_specific_note: stale_or_conflicting_evidence_use can be evaluated only when memory actually entered the generator prompt

cost.role: hard budget and least-cost tie-breaker among qualified positive actions
cost.not_allowed: cost savings cannot turn a no-benefit or harmful action into a positive open label

positive_open: the component was available and the intended treatment was realized
qualified paired measurement shows a material quality improvement
no prespecified material risk event worsens beyond its margin
cost remains within its frozen budget
nonpositive_off: qualified paired measurement shows control better
qualified paired measurement shows material equivalence
a prespecified material risk event worsens
unknown_exclude_from_effect_training: treatment was requested but not realized
human or judge outcome is uncertain
effect_label_states.discovery_sample_policy: A sample used to discover a stratum is never confirmatory/final evaluation. After the stratum is independently confirmed and its quality materiality is frozen or re-annotated, the discovery sample may be reused as train-only data.

ordered_gates: if no real eligible opportunity exists, keep the component off
if treatment realization or outcome measurement is invalid, mark unknown for training and keep off at inference
if probability of a material quality gain is below the frozen threshold, keep off
if any applicable material-risk constraint fails, keep off
if the cost budget fails, keep off
otherwise choose among formally valid actions composed only of qualified components; unsupported interactions remain masked and lower cost breaks ties

minimum_data_and_evaluation.splitting: user/dialogue-grouped out-of-fold; all duplicate, paraphrase, counterfactual, and source-item relatives stay in one group
minimum_data_and_evaluation.model: strongly regularized logistic regression or a depth-bounded tree over transparent pre-retrieval features; a semantic encoder is optional only if grouped validation adds value
reported_separately: each atomic risk event with its applicability denominator
minimum_data_and_evaluation.promotion_rule: one-standard-error preference for the smallest transparent model that beats the frozen baselines without failing risk or cost constraints

domain_and_distribution_policy.primary_rule: Train and evaluate component effects within observable opportunity strata; topic or corpus identity is not a target and cannot be used as a shortcut feature.
domain_and_distribution_policy.evoemo_role: fixed external stress/OOD diagnostic for observable request, boundary, burden, and opportunity strata; it is not a source of oracle PM effect labels
alignment_allowed: report results separately by preregistered observable strata
use train-only weights based only on sealed pre-outcome observable covariates
report target-population and unweighted estimates side by side
alignment_forbidden: resample or weight EvoEmo using response quality, risk, PM decisions, or judge outcomes
force marginal topic/emotion proportions to match ESConv and call that external generalization
treat states without a deployable longitudinal opportunity as ME negatives
domain_and_distribution_policy.interpretation: A distribution mismatch is a transport limitation to report, not something to hide by outcome-aware alignment.

current_evidence_state.rs: The 12-pair human sanity audit is complete and suggests a candidate advice-welcome/Providing-Suggestions stratum, but is not training-authorized because it is one annotation set with six advice pairs and no human ties.
current_evidence_state.memory: Oracle tests show clean single-item uptake capacity and multisource interference, not response-quality benefit, retriever quality, or PM learnability.
current_evidence_state.quality_judge: The first LLM pairwise quality instrument failed its frozen AB/BA consistency gate and cannot create hard effect labels.
current_evidence_state.risk_judge: The atomic material-risk rules are partially human-supported on the 12-pair audit; memory misuse still requires a memory-on audit.
